evidence.coverageBasis: Native-target statement coverage reported to one decimal place by go test ./... with a single count-mode coverage profile

rules.coverageFloor: Keep the audited 83.0% floor; this gives 0.6 percentage points below the lower hosted macOS/Linux result and 0.8 below repeated Windows results, all reported to one decimal place.
rules.maximumCrap: Use the repeated maximum rounded to two decimals with no upward headroom, so any increase fails.
rules.rounding: Coverage is parsed at the one-decimal precision emitted by go tool cover; reported CRAP uses midpoint-away-from-zero rounding to two decimals, while gates compare unrounded CRAP.
